product_one_liner.value: CyberCube provides cloud-based cyber-risk modeling and analytics for insurers, reinsurers and brokers to quantify risk, support underwriting and insurance placement, and manage portfolio exposure.
product_one_liner.notes: https://linkedin.com/company/18514105 describes the cloud platform's insurance-placement, underwriting and aggregation-management functions. https://www.cybcube.com/news/cybercube-launches-portfolio-manager-version-6 also identifies insurers, reinsurance brokers and reinsurers as users.

pricing_page.notes: The navigation and footer reviewed at https://www.cybcube.com/ provide product and contact links but no pricing link. Checking https://www.cybcube.com/pricing yielded no readable pricing page.

employee_band.notes: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/5a2e95c9e4b06bcd7d4664fb/cybercube#a:about reports 117 employees, which falls in the 101-200 band. This is a third-party headcount rather than a directly published current company count.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: CyberCube's company profile at https://linkedin.com/company/cybercube-analytics explicitly lists its headquarters as San Francisco, California. | hq_country: The company profile at https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/5a2e95c9e4b06bcd7d4664fb/cybercube#a:about identifies its location country as United States, consistent with its San Francisco headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company history at https://www.cybcube.com/about dates its beginnings within Symantec to 2015 and its independent launch to 2018. The answer uses the company's origin year; a third-party database instead lists 2016.

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying implementation posts are https://insights.cybcube.com/en/a-shift-from-aws-serverless-to-kubernetes, by Software Platform Architect Filipp Sorin, and https://insights.cybcube.com/en/migrating-lambda-functions-to-ecs, by software engineer Emmanuel Thioux. They describe CyberCube's architecture migration and Lambda-to-container implementation, respectively.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation or help link was found in the navigation/footer reviewed at https://www.cybcube.com/. The discovered documentation address, https://docs.atlas.cybcube.com/, presents a sign-in gate rather than publicly readable documentation articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open job board at https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/cybcube lists data engineering, marketing, insurance sales, cyber threat intelligence and actuarial roles, but no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title. Data engineering and security research duties were not counted as qualifying titles.

model_provider.notes: Unknown: https://www.cybcube.com/cybercube-ai describes a proprietary AI toolset without naming a model or model vendor. The subprocessors at https://security.cybcube.com/ identify AWS hosting and HubSpot, not a model provider. The AI report landing page and relevant blog were also reviewed without finding an explicit product-use disclosure; https://docs.atlas.cybcube.com/ requires sign-in. AWS hosting and hiring references to agent SDKs were not treated as evidence of a model used by the product.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current listings at https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/cybcube contain no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive title. The Senior Director, (Re)Insurance Sales position does not qualify under the specified title rules.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 13, 2026 announcement at https://www.cybcube.com/news/cybercube-blackpanda-asia-cyber-risk-analytics says Broking Manager now adds an APAC regional view to its benchmarks, enabling locally relevant peer comparisons. This is treated as a substantive new benchmarking capability within the six-month window, rather than merely a partner announcement or UI tweak. The announcement does not explicitly call it a 'major feature,' so that classification carries some uncertainty.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The February 9, 2026 announcement at https://www.cybcube.com/news/cybercube-announces-ceo-succession names Chris Methven as CEO, succeeding Pascal Millaire, who moved to Senior Advisor. This falls within the 12-month window.
